params.body:
## The defect

On the bid box ("plaats bod"), the remark field carried the words "extra opmerking" as grey text inside the box. Two things go wrong there at once: it reads as content someone already typed, and the moment the trader starts typing, the only sentence that said what the field is for disappears — exactly when he needs it. A placeholder also hangs on nothing: clicking it does nothing, and a screen reader announcing the field has no name to announce.

Found by Shane on staging, recorded as X-112.

## What changed

- **The remark field gets a real label above it**, tied to the field with `for`/`id` (`bid-note-<component id>`, so two bid boxes on one page can never share a label).
- **The placeholder is dropped, not replaced by an example.** This is a free remark field where anything may go, so any "example" would again be grey text in the box that is not actually there. The label carries the explanation; the box stays empty until the trader fills it.
- **The amount field next to it had the same break in a milder form.** It does carry a visible sentence ("Bedrag in €", plus "(excl. BTW)" on a VAT vehicle), but as a loose paragraph tied to nothing. That same sentence, in the same place, on the same line, is now a `label for` on the field — zero pixels of difference on screen, but a click on it focuses the field and a screen reader names it.
- **Its `0,00` placeholder stays.** That is an example of the *shape* of the answer, not a repeat of the *name* of the field, and that is the distinction that matters.

Nothing else in the bid box was restyled.

## Elsewhere (not touched)

Two other places carry inputs whose visible description is a placeholder. Both are table columns where the column header above the input does name the field, so they are weaker cases, not the same defect — listed here rather than widened into this change:

- `resources/views/livewire/offers.blade.php` — the filter row under the offers table (customer, manufacturer, model, price): the `<th>` above each input carries the name, the input itself has only a placeholder.
- `resources/views/stocklist/_tabs/offertemodal.blade.php` — the extras rows (name, amount, price): same shape, header above, placeholder in the field.

The export modals (`showUserModal`, `showAgreementModal`, `showBorderelModal`) are already correct: they use `x-ui.field` with a real label and use the placeholder only as an example (`0`, `0.00`).

## Documentation

- New screen rule **R B1-4.11** in `docs/bedrijfsregels/21-b1-biedingen.md`: every field of the bid form says what it is for, above or below the box, with a label tied to the field via `for`; the explanation is never grey text inside the box.
- Finding **X-112** recorded in `docs/bedrijfsregels/90-x-bevindingen.md` (solved section), with the reasoning for dropping the placeholder rather than replacing it.
- `docs/bedrijfsregels.html` and `docs/bedrijfsregels/92-testdekking-tabel.md` are generated and gitignored; they are not in this commit.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/BiddingBoxLabelTest.php` (tagged `@rule B1-4.11`) renders the Livewire component and reads it back with `DOMDocument`:

- the remark field is still bound to `note`, has an `id`, and has exactly one `<label for>` pointing at it with non-empty text;
- the remark field no longer carries a placeholder;
- the amount field is still bound to `price` and has a `<label for>` carrying "Bedrag".

All three fail against the previous markup (checked by running them against the old blade) and pass against this one.

`php artisan test --filter='Bid|Bidding|Export|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|RulesCoverage'` → OK (39 tests, 691 assertions).

Rendered through a running application and checked empty and with text typed in: both labels stay on screen while typing.
params.title: The bid remark field says what it is
